_readme: Manually-maintained indicators (judgment-based or not published as data). Automated inputs — metrTimeHorizon, eciCapability, epochBenchmarks, arcGap — come from adapters, not this file; entries whose key starts with an underscore are ignored by the pipeline and kept only as a record. Each entry: raw (source values consumed by domain/anchors.js), asOf, reviewBy, source, confidence (verified|provisional|judgment), _instructions, nextUpdate. reviewBy is an ISO date and is authoritative for staleness: the site shows each input's status (fresh / due / stale) and the daily workflow opens a GitHub issue for anything past it (see domain/freshness.js, DEPLOY.md). Set it from the entry's own documented cadence — and move it forward only after actually re-checking the source, never just to clear a warning. nextUpdate is a human-readable note. Anchor definitions live in research/anchor-tables.md.

selfLearning.source: CL-Bench (arXiv:2606.05661) — Gain barely positive across domains
selfLearning._instructions: gainRatio = observed Gain as fraction of human learning-curve improvement. Human baselines not yet published by CL-Bench, so this is judgment-tagged. Re-estimate when CL-Bench or successors publish comparable human curves.

realTimeEngagement.source: FutureWatch rubric D2 (research/anchor-tables.md); evidence: public voice-mode deployments (M1), group-chat demos (M2 partial)
realTimeEngagement._instructions: Quarterly scoring session. Each milestone 0/10/20 with written justification appended to scoringLog. Evidence standard: public demonstrations or peer-reviewed evals, not vendor marketing. Vaughan signs off.

scoringLog.note: Initial scoring at rubric approval. M1: real-time voice with interruption handling is deployed at consumer scale. M2: multi-party tracking shown in demos, not robust in the wild. M3-M5: no credible public evidence.

agenticAutonomyLevel.source: Morris et al. autonomy rubric (arXiv:2311.02462), scored on routine deployment
agenticAutonomyLevel._instructions: Quarterly. routineLevel ∈ tool|consultant|collaborator|expert|agent = highest level ROUTINE in deployed general-purpose systems. nextDemonstrated = next level credibly shown in limited settings (+10).

anthropicEconIndex._instructions: Update per AEI report (~quarterly). breadth = fraction of occupational categories with material AI task usage; depth = AI share of TOTAL work performed (NOT automation share of AI traffic — see anchor-tables.md challenge note). Both require reading the report's underlying data, not the headline stats. Flag: proxy for the economy via Claude usage; cross-check against aiIndexEconomy. As of 2026-10-02 the June 26 'Cadences' report is still the latest I could find — check for a newer one.

aiIndexEconomy.source: Stanford HAI AI Index 2026, Economy chapter (hai.stanford.edu/ai-index)
aiIndexEconomy._instructions: Annual (~April). adoption01 = firm genAI adoption rebased 2019=0, near-universal=1. postings01 = AI share of job postings rebased likewise. Weakest anchor set in the system — candidate for replacement if a better public series appears.

friLeapAgi.source: Forecasting Research Institute — LEAP panel, Wave 8 (forecastingresearch.org); cf. Samotsvety Forecasting (~28% probability of AGI by 2030)
friLeapAgi._instructions: Replaces the old Metaculus-API expectation feed (Metaculus stopped serving live aggregation data via API, 2026-07, anti-abuse policy — see decision log D4). LEAP surveys AI experts and superforecasters monthly; medianYear is conditional on AGI occurring, using LEAP's definition (commercially available system beating 90th-percentile professionals on 90% of economically useful non-physical tasks at <=5x human labor cost — NOT the same definition as metrTimeHorizon, do not conflate). Check forecastingresearch.substack.com each wave; update on a >=1yr shift in either median, quarterly review minimum. REVIEW OVERDUE: Wave 8 (Apr 20-May 11) is the last AGI-year number I found, but Waves 9 (Jun 30) and 10 (Jul 28) have been published and haven't been read for timeline updates; the field has also moved a great deal since May.

raw.evidence: Summer 2026 scorecard, Existential Safety row (companies in FLI's order Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Meta, Z.ai, Alibaba Cloud, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral): D+ D+ D F F F F F F. Overall: Anthropic C+ (2.66), OpenAI C (2.28), Google DeepMind C (2.01).

fliSafetyIndex._instructions: Semiannual (summer/winter). existentialGrade = best lab's grade in the scorecard's Existential Safety row — read the TABLE, not the prose: the page text says 'No company exceeds C-', a loose upper bound that was previously entered as the grade (corrected to D+ on 2026-10-02, decision D5). This drives the divergence bar (harsher-grade decision, anchor-tables.md). overallBestGpa recorded for context display only.

_retired_hendrycksAgiScore.source: Hendrycks et al., A Definition of AGI (arXiv:2510.18212, agidefinition.ai)
_retired_hendrycksAgiScore._instructions: Update when the consortium publishes a score for a new frontier model. Use their number verbatim; do not interpolate between models. STALE: agidefinition.ai still lists only GPT-4 (27%) and GPT-5 (57%) as of 2026-10-02, while at least a dozen frontier models have shipped since. Decision D8: replace with an Epoch Capabilities Index–based indicator (Tier 1); reviewBy is 6 months after the last score.
_retired_hendrycksAgiScore._retired: 2026-10-02, decision D8: replaced by the automated eciCapability indicator (Epoch Capabilities Index, two-point calibration through the GPT-4 and GPT-5 AGI scores published at agidefinition.ai). agidefinition.ai still lists only GPT-4 (27%) and GPT-5 (57%).

_retired_epochBenchmarks._instructions: TEMPORARY placeholder — mean fraction-of-expert-human across {GPQA Diamond, SWE-bench Verified, FrontierMath, HLE}, set by judgment. Replace with the automated Epoch adapter (Tier 1): Epoch publishes this data as a CC-BY ZIP at epoch.ai/data/benchmark_data.zip (refreshed daily). As of 2026-10-02 the frontier on those four is roughly GPQA 95.8%, SWE-bench Verified 83.5%, FrontierMath T1-3 93.7%, HLE 54.8%.
_retired_epochBenchmarks._retired: 2026-10-02: replaced by the automated Epoch adapter (frontier basket B-2026.1 from epoch.ai/data/benchmark_data.zip).

_retired_arcGap.source: ARC Prize technical reports (arXiv:2601.10904, arXiv:2603.24621); verify current at arcprize.org
_retired_arcGap._instructions: Update from arcprize.org leaderboards quarterly. frontierOverHuman = frontier score / human score per active generation. Generations retire at ratio > 0.85 (ratchet rule) — log retirement in decision log. STALE (overdue since 2026-06-30): as of 2026-10-02 the official leaderboard (arcprize.org/media/data/leaderboard/v3.json) shows ARC-AGI-2 at 95.0% (retires under the ratchet) and ARC-AGI-3 at 62.7% on the Standard harness / 99.9% on the Provider Adapter harness; the 0.005 here is the earliest ARC-AGI-3 result. Decision D6: score the Standard harness, display the Provider Adapter result alongside. Refresh lands with the Tier 1/2 re-baseline (D7), not as a silent edit.
_retired_arcGap._retired: 2026-10-02: replaced by the automated ARC Prize adapter (arcprize.org leaderboard JSON; ARC-AGI-3 scored on the Standard harness, decision D6).
